def transform(g):
 rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if all(v==row[0] for v in row) and row[0] not in (0,2,7)]
 # separators uniform color 4 or 9
 h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); rowcuts=[-1]+rows+[h]; colcuts=[-1]+[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] and g[r][c] in (4,9) for r in range(h))]+[w]
 # safer locate separator columns uniform values 4/9; rows similarly
 out=[]
 for ra,rb in zip(rowcuts,rowcuts[1:]):
  if ra+1>=rb: continue
  line=[]
  for ca,cb in zip(colcuts,colcuts[1:]):
   if ca+1>=cb: continue
   vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(ra+1,rb) for c in range(ca+1,cb)]
   from collections import Counter
   bg=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
   line.append(1 if sum(v!=bg for v in vals)==2 else bg)
  out.append(line)
 return out
transform(test)

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform separator rows and columns divide the grid into nine panels.
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] in (4, 9)]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] in (4, 9)]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    result = []
    for ra, rb in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        output_row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            panel = [grid[r][c] for r in range(ra + 1, rb) for c in range(ca + 1, cb)]
            background = Counter(panel).most_common(1)[0][0]
            output_row.append(1 if sum(value != background for value in panel) == 2 else background)
        result.append(output_row)
    return result
'''
